选择的目录已是当前 skills 库位置。: The selected folder is already the current library location.
迁移并校验 skills 库: Moving and verifying the skills library
skills 库位置已更新。原目录保留在 {path}；确认使用正常后，可自行删: Library location updated. The original folder is kept at {path}. After checking that everything works, you can delete this backup yourself.
选择新目录后预览迁移。已有 skills 和版本会一起迁移，并更新受管理的项目链: Choose a new folder to preview the move. Existing skills and versions will move together, and managed project links will be updated.
迁移会复制并校验全部库内容，然后切换到新目录。目标必须为空目录或空的 Askil: The move copies and verifies all library content before switching to the new folder. Choose an empty folder or an empty Askills library; existing libraries cannot be merged.
原目录会保留作备份。迁移成功并确认使用正常后，可自行删除原目录。: The original folder will be kept as a backup. After a successful move, check that everything works before deleting it yourself.
复制期间可以取消；进入切换阶段后会先安全完成操作。: You can cancel during copying. Once the switch begins, it will finish safely before returning.
备注仅用于 Askills 显示，不改变项目文件夹名称或路径。留空可恢复原名。: This nickname is only used in Askills. The project folder name and path stay the same. Leave it empty to restore the original name.
技能将从库列表移除，版本快照和已安装的项目技能保留。重新导入同一来源可以恢复；此: Skills will be removed from the library list. Version snapshots and installed project skills are kept. Reimport the same source to restore them. This does not free snapshot disk space.
项目将从管理列表移除，项目文件和已安装技能保留。重新添加同一项目文件夹可以恢复备: Projects will be removed from the list. Project files and installed skills are kept. Add the same folder again to restore its nickname and management records.
所选技能的安装路径重复，请分别安装并选择要保留的来源。: Selected skills share an installation path. Install them separately and choose which source to keep.
逐项检查后应用；失败项保留供重试，已成功项不会重复安装。: Changes are checked and applied individually. Failed items remain available to retry; successful items are not installed again.
技能已保存，但无法读取安装版本，请从项目技能库重新选择。: The skill was saved, but its installable version could not be read. Select it again from the project library.
技能已保存，请继续预览当前项目的安装变更。: Skill saved. Continue to preview the installation changes for this project.
技能已保存到本地库，现有项目的版本保持不变。: Skill saved to your library. Existing project versions are unchanged.
项目已登记，可以选择项目扫描技能。: Project added. Select it to scan for skills.
检查项目并生成安装计划: Checking the project and preparing an installation plan
已通过 {mode} 启用技能。请在对应 Agent 中刷新或开启新会话验证加载: Skill enabled using {mode}. Refresh the agent or start a new session to verify that it loads.
项目变更已完成，技能库中的版本仍然保留。: Project updated. Versions in your library are retained.
已请求取消；正在完成当前安全步骤。: Cancellation requested. Finishing the current safe step.
外观、主题色与本地数据。: Appearance, accent colors and local data.
首次导入前可以更换目录。已有技能库的迁移向导将在后续提供。: You can change the folder before your first import. Migration of existing libraries is planned for a future release.
可切换中文和英文界面，技能正文按原文展示。: Switch between Chinese and English. Skill documents remain in their original language.
界面语言保存在本地，重启后保留。: Your language is saved locally and kept after restart.
完整目录将保存为快照，原始目录不会改动。: The complete folder is saved as a snapshot. The original folder is unchanged.
请先到“项目”页面添加一个项目文件夹。: Add a project folder on the Projects page first.
用于共享仓库、远程环境或容器时，建议选择复制。: Copy is recommended for shared repositories, remote environments and containers.
下一步将预览实际写入路径。: Next, preview the actual destination path.
应用前会再次检查版本和目标目录，已有非管理文件不会被覆盖。: The version and destination are checked again before applying. Existing unmanaged files will not be overwritten.
限定深度扫描，跳过依赖目录与链接目录。: Scanning uses a depth limit and skips dependency folders and linked directories.
没有发现 Git 工作区或已知技能目录，也可以直接添加项目文件夹。: No Git workspaces or known skill directories found. You can also add a project folder directly.
仅停用 Askills 管理的项目入口，技能库内容保留。检测到外部修改时将停止操: Only the project entry managed by Askills is disabled. Library content is retained. The operation stops if external changes are detected.
把当前项目恢复到上一个受管理版本，其他项目保持不变。: Restore this project to its previous managed version. Other projects are unchanged.

仅改变 Askills 中的显示，原始名称、SKILL.md 和项目安装路径保持: Only the display in Askills changes. The original name, SKILL.md and project installation paths are unchanged. Leave blank to restore the original name.
查看项目现有技能，管理每个项目使用的版本。: Inspect existing skills and manage the version each project uses.
选择项目文件夹，自动识别 Codex、Cursor 等工具的技能目录。: Choose a project folder to detect skill directories for Codex, Cursor and other tools.
从技能库选择一个技能，点击“添加到项目”。: Choose a skill in the library and click “Add to project”.
没有发现现有技能目录。可以从技能库添加。: No existing skill directories found. Add skills from your library.
扫描只读取文件。多个工具可能同时读取同一个兼容目录。: Scanning only reads files. Multiple tools may read the same compatible directory.
选择项目查看技能: Select a project to view its skills
同时展示已管理的部署和项目中的现有技能。: View managed deployments alongside skills already present in the project.
技能库还是空的，可以切换到“从云端”或“从本地”。: Your library is empty. Switch to “From cloud” or “From local folder”.
选择包含 SKILL.md 的完整目录，预览并保存到技能库，然后继续为当前项目安: Choose the complete folder containing SKILL.md. Preview and save it to your library, then continue installation for this project.
接下来选择部署方式并预览目标路径。: Next, choose a deployment method and preview the destination.

从 GitHub 获取技能，保存到自己的本地库。: Get skills from GitHub and save them to your local library.
使用已安装的 Git，沿用本机代理和凭据配置。在独立临时仓库拉取固定提交，不合并: Uses your installed Git, proxy and credential settings to fetch a pinned commit in an isolated temporary repository. Your projects are unchanged and GitHub API quota is not used. Enter an HTTPS repository URL; interactive sign-in prompts are disabled.
通过 GitHub API 获取公共仓库，不需要安装 Git。: Uses the GitHub API for public repositories. Git installation is not required.
输入仓库地址，选择版本，再预览需要导入的技能。: Enter a repository URL, choose a version, then preview the skills to import.
留空使用默认分支: Leave blank for the default branch
下载固定到完整 commit。不会执行仓库脚本，项目不会跟随来源自动升级。: Downloads are pinned to a full commit. Repository scripts are never run. Project skills do not upgrade automatically.
该版本没有找到 SKILL.md。: No SKILL.md found in this version.
这些是本项目开发 skills 的来源，属于第三方社区内容。: These repositories supply this project's development skills and contain third-party community content.

请输入 #RRGGBB 格式的六位颜色。: Enter a six-digit color in #RRGGBB format.
主题色用于按钮、选择状态与焦点提示。设置会自动保存，重启后保留。: Accent colors apply to buttons, selections and focus indicators. Settings are saved locally and kept after restart.
请在 Askills 桌面应用中执行本地操作。: Use the Askills desktop app for local operations.
未发现许可证声明；请核对上游授权后再分发: No license declaration found. Check upstream permission before redistributing.
包含 scripts；Askills 不执行脚本，安装后 Agent 可能按指令: Contains scripts. Askills does not execute them, but an agent may run them after installation.

没有匹配的字体，已保留当前字体和默认选项。: No matching fonts. The current font and default remain available.
当前字体未安装，已自动使用默认字体显示。: The selected font is not installed. The default font is used instead.
使用本机已安装的字体，选择后自动保存。安装新字体后可刷新列表。: Use installed fonts. Your choice is saved automatically. Refresh the list after installing a font.
